title: A free kick: Bernoulli(0.3)
caption: Out of 10 equally likely shares, 7 are misses (X = 0) and 3 are goals (X = 1), so the mean is 0.3 and the SD is √(0.3 × 0.7) ≈ 0.458.
alt: Bar chart with X = 0 at height 7 and X = 1 at height 3, in tenths.
description: The mean of an indicator variable is the probability of the 1: E(X) = 0.3.
